title: Burned-out campfire shows three hours of missing time
place_text: Smith Brook campsite, Eagle Lake, Maine

tellings.quote: And when we got back to shore, the fire was extinguished. So, that was a 3hour period of time. That is that missing time that everybody talks about.

plain: In 1976, at the Smith Brook campsite on Eagle Lake in Maine, a group of campers came back to shore to find their big campfire burned out, and they took it as proof that about three hours had gone by that none of them remembered. Charlie Foltz, one of the campers, tells Michels this himself: "that was a 3hour period of time. That is that missing time that everybody talks about," meaning the gap in memory that people who report alien encounters often describe. If true, the dead fire is a physical clock showing that time really went missing.
